title: YRG Cobblemon Racism Controversy: JayMommy hits back at critics; streamer vows to stay
summary_full: JayMommy has responded to the criticism surrounding her comments during the YRG Cobblemon event, standing by her position and calling many of her critics “losers.” She also confirmed she will keep playing on the YRG Cobblemon server despite the backlash. Meanwhile, YourRAGE briefly reacted to the situation, saying he hoped everyone involved was okay.
